HyperSIGMA: selected unmodified ImageClassification model files and ViT optimizer from the author-provided HyperSIGMA checkout. Apache-2.0 license is retained in HyperSIGMA/LICENSE.

lvae/: modified QARV/LoSSy-VAE implementation by Zhihao Duan, https://github.com/duanzhiihao/lossy-vae. TriTAC adds HSI input, TriLM and prefix coding.

The upstream QARV README states: "Code in this repository is freely available for non-commercial use."
Source: https://github.com/duanzhiihao/lossy-vae#license (checked 2026-10-31).
This release does not relicense those components.

HyperSIGMA upstream: https://github.com/WHU-Sigma/HyperSIGMA
